info.title: Expert Amp Server API
info.description:
Trusted-LAN HTTP API for Expert Amp Server. The service is intended for local station networks and should not be exposed directly to the public internet. The canonical phase 1 surface lives under /api/v1. This spec intentionally documents current implementation reality, including conservative or fallback-derived fields. It does not treat legacy compatibility routes as canonical, and it does not list older non-v1 aliases except where needed for explanatory context.

Status honesty rules:
- GET /api/v1/status is the preferred machine-readable amp status surface.
- Status fields may be protocol-native, display-derived fallback, compatibility aliases, or current conservative placeholders depending on what the runtime actually knows.
- GET /api/v1/telemetry remains useful for UI and fallback inspection, but it is not the authoritative automation contract when protocol-native status poll data is available.
- GET /api/v1/alarms returns protocol-native warnings/alarms, configurable monitoring, and read-only state for the separately armed one-shot overtemperature standby controller.
- Active standby requires fresh OPERATE and RX evidence before one documented OPERATE command; the write remains sent/unconfirmed because the protocol cannot correlate a later response.
- The websocket status feed shares the same canonical status model but is described separately because OpenAPI does not model websocket message flow well.

X-Expert-Amp-Version.description: Build version string for the running binary.

get.description: Returns build metadata for the running binary. Values are injected at build time when release scripts use -ldflags; development builds report version/channel as dev.
Human-facing local docs page served by the app. It reads /api/v1/openapi.json and renders a simple local reference UI.
Returns the current 8x40 runtime display state by default. Optional fixture selection is for protocol inspection and does not mutate runtime state.

Returns a screen-reader-friendly view of the current runtime LCD. rows always contains eight strings of exactly 40 characters, preserving physical geometry. highlightedSpans use zero-based rows and inclusive startColumn/exclusive endColumn coordinates. Custom glyphs are left blank rather than assigned guessed semantics; screenText retains the existing trimmed frame text as a fallback, and /api/v1/display/state remains the raw character/attribute source.
Returns runtime frame metadata by default. Optional fixture selection returns fixture frame metadata instead.

200.description: PNG render of the selected display state
SVG render of the selected display state

get.description: WebSocket endpoint that emits a lightweight event each time the authoritative runtime display snapshot changes. The watch UI uses this to refresh /api/v1/display/render.png when a new frame is available instead of blind browser polling. Legacy HTTP render endpoints remain available for polling consumers.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade accepted. Text messages carry display refresh events with sequence, updatedAt, source, and frameKind.

get.description: Preferred automation surface. Protocol-native status poll data wins when present. Display-derived telemetry fills gaps conservatively. Some fields remain omitted rather than guessed.

WebSocket endpoint for the same canonical status model returned by GET /api/v1/status. After connect, the server sends one status snapshot immediately and then pushes changed snapshots only. Delivery is event-driven from the authoritative status path. The canonical endpoint does not support pace query strings. OpenAPI does not model websocket frames cleanly, so this operation is documented descriptively rather than with a full message schema exchange.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade accepted. Text messages carry Status objects without the standard envelope.

get.description: UI-friendly runtime telemetry and fallback inspection surface. Useful, but not the canonical machine status contract when protocol-native status exists.

get.summary: Get active alarms and safety monitoring
get.description: Returns protocol-native vendor warnings and alarms plus configurable temperature and TX-only SWR threshold evaluation. Monitoring is observational by default. A separate explicit arm flag permits one documented OPERATE command per latched overtemperature episode when fresh protocol-native status explicitly says OPERATE and RX. The write remains sent/unconfirmed because the toggle protocol has neither command acknowledgement nor request/response correlation. SWR never actuates. The GET handler only reports state.

get.summary: Get fan-policy and manual override state
get.description: Returns automatic thresholds, manual override state, hottest protocol-native temperature observation, desired policy and source, last display-verified current policy with confidence/source, persistence status, safety gates, cooldown, and navigation receipt. GET is read-only. Active control requires polling mode both. Users are encouraged to test manual Fan Boost before enabling automatic control. Navigation starts only after protocol status and checksum-valid LCD flags report RX at a recognized home screen, then stops on any menu mismatch. If initially OPERATE, the controller obtains exclusive actuation ownership, requests STANDBY once, and requires newer protocol and LCD STANDBY evidence before SET. It restores OPERATE only after verified SAVE and return home, and only if it owned the original transition. TX pauses all writes and timeouts. Overtemperature safety preempts fan control and suppresses restoration.

post.description: Requests automatic temperature control, forced Normal, or forced CONTEST through the same fail-closed temporary-STANDBY display-verification transaction. Omitting durationMinutes keeps a Normal or CONTEST override active until another request changes it. Optional durationMinutes expires back to automatic control. The request is accepted before navigation completes; poll GET /api/v1/fan-policy for the verified result.

post.summary: Verify the persisted amplifier fan mode
post.description: Queues a safe menu transaction that reads the captured FAN MANAGEMENT value, follows the known SAVE path, and refreshes the server-owned verified receipt. Use after startup or a disconnected/manual change. A persisted receipt is stale until this transaction or a complete observed front-panel SAVE sequence refreshes it.

get.description: In fixture mode this returns connected=false and a fixture-mode explanation instead of pretending a live serial path exists.

post.description: Requests a clean process exit. A host supervisor such as systemd, launchd, or a Docker restart policy must bring the process back. If no supervisor is present, the process stops and stays stopped.

Writes local config. Preferred polling fields are pollingMode (off, both, status, display) and pollIntervalMs. both alternates status and display writes on one cadence; status is for automation/API, display is for front-panel/template work, and off is diagnostic. Legacy polling booleans and statusPollIntervalMs remain accepted/readable for compatibility and are normalized on save.

Sends a real document-backed one-button command through the held live serial port when live ingest is active, or through a short-lived configured serial connection when live ingest is not active. Exposed command names are transport-real, but several still need hardware confirmation before their on-device semantics should be treated as fully trusted. back, on, and standby remain intentionally blocked on this endpoint; use /api/v1/actions/wake for the experimental wake/power-on path.

post.summary: Wake the amp via serial control-line jiggle
post.description: Sends the experimental amp wake/power-on path by toggling DTR/RTS on the configured FTDI serial transport. This is intentionally separate from the documented front-panel button endpoint and still needs hardware validation across amps/cabling.

KindQuery.name: kind
KindQuery.description: Optional fixture kind for protocol inspection. Supported values depend on built-in fixtures, typically home, menu, or panel.

SourceQuery.name: source
SourceQuery.description: Optional fixture source selector. source=protocol with no explicit kind currently defaults to the home fixture.

ScaleQuery.name: scale
ScaleQuery.description: Render scale multiplier, clamped to 1 through 8.

BasicSuccessResponse.description: Standard success envelope without a structured data payload

ActionErrorResponse.description: Action error envelope that may still include transport details in data

rows.description: Decoded LCD rows with physical spacing preserved. Unknown/custom glyphs decode as spaces.

highlightedSpans.description: Contiguous reverse-video ranges in row-major order.

selectedText.description: Non-blank highlighted span text, trimmed and joined with newlines in row-major order.

screenText.description: Existing trimmed frame decoder output retained as a fallback.

text.description: Decoded text across the complete highlighted geometry.

LCDFlags.description: GetLCD flag word. rawInverted is the inverted little-endian word from bytes 7..8; decoded is rawInverted XOR 0xffff. When checksumValid is true, leds exposes front-panel LED bits for the amp-shaped UI.

LCDLEDs.description: Front-panel LED states decoded from checksum-valid LCD flags. operate, set, tune, and the 0x0800 tx bit were validated on live Expert 1.3K-FA hardware; other models still need their own confirmation.

Telemetry.description: Current runtime telemetry snapshot. Many fields are omitted when unknown. source, confidence, provenance, and notes matter and should not be ignored.

operatingState.description: Usually standby or operate when known.

mode.description: Current compatibility alias for operating state when present.

antennaSwr.description: SWR at the antenna side of the ATU when the documented status poll provides it.

antennaSwrDisplay.description: Display/raw companion for antennaSwr when available.

paSupplyVoltage.description: PA supply voltage when the documented status poll provides it.

paSupplyVoltageDisplay.description: Display/raw companion for paSupplyVoltage when available.

paCurrent.description: PA current when the documented status poll provides it.

paCurrentDisplay.description: Display/raw companion for paCurrent when available.

temperatureC.description: Canonical Celsius temperature. Unitless status-poll readings are converted using amplifierTemperatureUnit.

temperatureUnit.description: Unit associated with temperatureDisplay and the amplifier's raw status-poll reading.

temperatureDisplay.description: Operator display value in the amplifier's configured temperature unit.

temperatureLowerC.description: Lower heatsink temperature when reported by the amp model.

temperatureLowerDisplay.description: Display/raw companion for temperatureLowerC when available.

temperatureCombinerC.description: Combiner temperature when reported by the amp model.

temperatureCombinerDisplay.description: Display/raw companion for temperatureCombinerC when available.

frequency.description: Omitted when current captures do not justify a value.

confidence.description: Examples include display-derived, fixture-derived, or protocol-native.

recentContact.description: Conservative recent-contact indicator, not the same as operate or TX state.

bandCode.description: Raw protocol status code when available.

bandText.description: Decoded text companion for bandCode when available.

warningCode.description: Raw protocol status warning code when available.

alarmCode.description: Raw protocol status alarm code when available.

atuStatusCode.description: Raw ATU status code from the documented status poll antenna/status field.

warnings.description: Compatibility alias of warningsText when available.

activeAlarms.description: Compatibility alias of alarmsText when available.

warningCode.description: Raw protocol status warning code when available.

alarmCode.description: Raw protocol status alarm code when available.

armed.description: True only when one-shot overtemperature standby is explicitly armed.

dryRun.description: True when overtemperature standby is not armed. SWR remains observational even when false.

actionsTaken.description: Contains the one guarded standby request description after it has been sent.

latched.description: Prevents another automatic write until temperature falls below the reset threshold.

enabled.description: Whether automatic temperature-based fan policy is enabled.

controlActive.description: True when automatic policy, a manual override, or an explicit verification request can drive the verified navigator.

blockedBy.description: Fail-closed action gates that are not currently satisfied.

currentPolicy.description: The last policy verified after the controller's SET-on-SAVE write and a newer captured home screen. STORING DATA! is accepted when observed but can be shorter than one display-poll interval. A persisted value can be stale after restart until reverified.

currentPolicyVerifiedAt.description: Timestamp of the last fully verified SAVE and return-home sequence.

currentPolicySource.description: Source of the verification receipt, such as automatic-temperature, manual-override, startup-verification, api-verification, or observed-front-panel-save.

persistenceError.description: Present when server-owned fan-policy state could not be persisted. Live verified state remains visible but will not survive restart.

cooldownUntil.description: When present, automatic Normal restoration is delayed until this time to limit persistent settings writes. Explicit manual Normal and high cooling are never delayed.

actionAvailable.description: True when a live button transport exists. The transaction still requires recognized live display waypoints before each write.

durationMinutes.description: Present while a timed override is waiting for display verification. Its countdown has not started yet.

until.description: Set after a timed override is display-verified and its countdown starts. If both durationMinutes and until are absent, the override remains active until explicitly changed.

durationMinutes.description: Optional for Normal or CONTEST. The countdown begins after the requested mode is display-verified. Omit to keep the override active until explicitly changed.

state.description: Idle, failed, complete, or the exact expected display-navigation step.

lastVerifiedScreen.description: Last semantic LCD waypoint verified by the captured profile.

paused.description: True while every menu write and the ordinary waypoint timeout are suspended for TX or missing checksum-valid LCD RX evidence.

pauseReason.description: Why navigation is paused and what RX evidence is required before the exact expected waypoint can resume it.

mayBeInMenu.description: Conservative flag indicating a SET write may have reached the amp and the server has not since verified the home screen.

changedOperatingState.description: True after this transaction has verified that its OPERATE command moved the amplifier into STANDBY.

restoreOperatePending.description: True when this transaction originally disabled OPERATE and restoration is still pending or requires operator recovery.

recoveryState.description: Automatic menu recovery is disabled until a safe EXIT path is hardware-captured.

recoveryInstructions.description: Physical-front-panel recovery guidance when the amplifier may remain in a menu.

observation.description: Later status/contact evidence without claiming a protocol command acknowledgement.

temperatureResetC.description: Latch reset threshold. When zero/unset, temperatureWarningC is used.

pollingMode.description: Unified serial polling mode. Preferred over legacy polling booleans.

amplifierTemperatureUnit.description: Unit selected in the amplifier SET menu for unitless status-poll temperature values. API *C fields and all safety/fan thresholds remain Celsius.

pollingMode.description: Unified serial polling mode. Preferred over legacy polling booleans.

panelModelLabel.description: Optional cosmetic label for the amp-shaped front-panel model/callsign text. Does not change protocol status identity.

inputLabels.description: Optional cosmetic labels for amp inputs keyed by input number as a string.

antennaLabels.description: Optional cosmetic labels for antenna ports keyed by antenna number as a string.

safetyMonitoringEnabled.description: Enables threshold evaluation. This alone remains observational.

overtemperatureStandbyArmed.description: Explicitly arms one guarded OPERATE-to-STANDBY request per overtemperature episode. Defaults false.

automaticFanPolicyEnabled.description: Enables the disabled-by-default display-verified automatic fan-policy controller. Manual Fan Boost testing is recommended first. Requires pollingMode both. If initially OPERATE, the controller temporarily enters and verifies STANDBY for the menu transaction, then restores OPERATE only after a verified save. Every write is RX-only and TX pauses navigation.

fanHighTemperatureC.description: Requests the model's verified high-cooling policy at or above this temperature.

fanNormalTemperatureC.description: Requests Normal fan policy at or below this temperature. Must be at least 5 C below fanHighTemperatureC; a verified high-cooling SAVE starts a 15-minute Normal-only restore cooldown.

fanDisplayProfile.description: Legacy compatibility field. The current experimental path is selected automatically and verifies observed screens at runtime.

verifyFanModeOnStartup.description: Queues one verified menu transaction after process startup so an EEPROM-backed fan mode changed while disconnected is not trusted from the persisted receipt alone.

fanBoostDurationMinutes.description: Built-in UI default for manual Fan Boost. Zero means until explicitly changed.

SettingsUpdateRequest.description: Accepted settings write shape. Legacy serialPoll* aliases remain accepted by the server for backward compatibility. The documented status poll frame itself is fixed in code rather than user-editable.

amplifierTemperatureUnit.description: Must match the amplifier SET-menu temperature unit. Takes effect on the next status frame; API *C fields and all safety/fan thresholds remain Celsius.

pollingMode.description: Unified serial polling mode. Preferred over legacy polling booleans.

panelModelLabel.description: Optional cosmetic label for the amp-shaped front-panel model/callsign text. Does not change protocol status identity.

inputLabels.description: Optional cosmetic labels for amp inputs keyed by input number as a string.

antennaLabels.description: Optional cosmetic labels for antenna ports keyed by antenna number as a string.

safetyMonitoringEnabled.description: Enables threshold evaluation. At least one complete warning/trip pair is required when true.

overtemperatureStandbyArmed.description: Separately opts in to one guarded OPERATE-to-STANDBY request per latched overtemperature episode. Requires enabled monitoring and a complete temperature pair.

temperatureResetC.description: Must be below temperatureTripC when set; zero uses temperatureWarningC.

automaticFanPolicyEnabled.description: Explicitly enables fan-policy evaluation. Defaults false and requires pollingMode both. Manual Fan Boost testing is recommended first. Navigation starts only for Expert-family model telemetry from a verified RX home screen, temporarily enters verified STANDBY when initially OPERATE, pauses all writes during TX, and restores OPERATE only after verified save completion.

fanHighTemperatureC.description: Must be at least 5 C greater than fanNormalTemperatureC and, when overtemperature standby is armed, lower than temperatureTripC.

fanNormalTemperatureC.description: Must be at least 5 C lower than fanHighTemperatureC. Normal restoration is held for 15 minutes after a verified high-cooling SAVE.

fanDisplayProfile.description: Legacy compatibility field; no longer required to use the experimental verified path.

verifyFanModeOnStartup.description: Requests a verified fan-mode read/save transaction after each process start. The last verified receipt is server-owned and is not accepted through the settings API.

fanBoostDurationMinutes.description: Built-in UI default for manual Fan Boost. Zero means until explicitly changed.

name.description: Document-backed action name. Current supported names include input, band-, band+, antenna, l-, l+, c-, c+, tune, off, power, display, operate, cat, left, right, up, down, set, backlight-on, and backlight-off. back, on, and standby remain blocked on this endpoint; use POST /api/v1/actions/wake for the experimental wake path.

version.description: Release version or dev for local builds.

commit.description: Git commit used for the build when injected.

channel.description: Update/release channel such as dev, stable, or nightly.
